headline: Judges urge Israel to drop Netanyahu bribery case
pages: Judges in Jerusalem on Wednesday told Israel's attorney general that prosecutors should reconsider the bribery charges against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. In a highly unusual step, the panel summoned Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara to say the chance of conviction in Case 4000 was low. That case alleges favors for positive media coverage. The judges also doubted that the conduct in a second case, Case 2000, amounts to a crime. They suggested prosecutors seek a plea deal in the third, Case 1000, which involves gifts from an Australian billionaire. Baharav-Miara said she would consider the recommendations.

Netanyahu, who has denied wrongdoing since he was charged in 2019, called for the trial to end immediately. He described ten years of suffering for his family. The caretaker prime minister is fighting for his political survival, so the development could give him a boost. Source: BBC News.
